_about: Public-domain Otto Pfleiderer (1839-1908, Jena and Berlin) in English for the Word Hoard: Paulinism, tr. Edward Peters (2 vols, 1877), The Philosophy of Religion on the Basis of its History, tr. Alexander Stewart and Allan Menzies (4 vols, 1886-1888), the Hibbert Lectures on the influence of Paul (1885), The Development of Theology in Germany since Kant (1890), the Gifford Lectures (2 vols, 1894), Primitive Christianity, tr. W. Montgomery (4 vols, 1906-1911), and six other books, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
